points.description: Storage volume vs elevation (storage–elevation relationship) of the reservoir.
points.partial_credit: Mentions storage or capacity of reservoir without relating it to elevation.

points.description: Water surface elevation vs outflow (outflow–elevation relationship, e.g. spillway/outlet rating).
points.partial_credit: Mentions outflow or discharge characteristics without relating to elevation.

rubric.notes: The model answer lists four items; initial values of S, I and Q at t=0 are folded into the marking as a bonus-equivalent: award full 2 marks if any three of the four items are clearly given, and treat the initial conditions as an acceptable substitute for any one of the three listed points. Give 1 mark for one or two correct items, or for vague items. Give 0 for unrelated answers such as rainfall or evaporation only.
